meaning: For the actual uniform measure on Fin N with N>0 and 0<t≤1, threshold beliefs are conjunction closed exactly when 1-1/N<t. For every fixed 0<t<1 there is N≥2 for which closure fails, every ticket-losing event is accepted, and their common intersection is empty. Changing the threshold with context or restricting licensed events is a distinct policy; the result does not refute pro tanto reasons.
